images.description: Player playing table tennis in action

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark mode 'Performance Pro' archetype. Avoid generic Vercel/Stripe 'soft' aesthetics. Use sharp edges or max 4px border-radius.

Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts like Dashboards and Grids. Shadcn UI should only be used for complex interactions (Dialogs, Select, Tabs, Calendars) and MUST be heavily customized to remove the default rounded corners and soft shadows.
Typography: Use 'Bebas Neue' for all Headings (H1, H2, H3) and large numeric scores. Use 'Manrope' for body copy, UI text, and tables. CRITICAL: Never use 'Inter'.
Layout Strategy: Build a dense 'Control Room' grid. Utilize left-alignment for all data tables and lists to maximize scanability. Do NOT center text heavily.
Color Usage: Use Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A) as the main canvas. Colors act as functional signals, not decoration. Only use Electric Blaze (#FF3B30) for critical live states and CTAs.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are added to EVERY button, link, and major block for automated testing compatibility.
Avoid full-screen generic gradients. Use the 'Tracing Beam' or 'Grid Borders' approach to separate sections instead of floating cards with soft shadows.
